project_name: Sree Bloomy Graphics Pvt. Ltd. — Premium Interactive Web Catalogue
design_direction: Swiss-Inspired Technical Catalogue with Alternating Bone White and Dark Charcoal (#0E0E10) Full-Bleed Sections

typography.heading_font: Neue Haas Grotesk / Inter (Sans Display, bold, tight tracking)
typography.editorial_serif: Cormorant Garamond / Playfair Display (Italic serif for pull quotes and chairman philosophy)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (Technical telemetry, specs, dot gain metrics, coordinates)

scale.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-bold tracking-tighter leading-none

layout_and_grid.alternating_sections: Section 1 (Hero - Dark) -> Section 2 (Rebrand - Light) -> Section 3 (Outcomes - Dark) -> Section 4 (Why Sree Bloomy - Light) -> Section 5 (Kodak NX - Dark) -> Section 6 (Esko CDI - Light) -> Section 7 (Shine LED - Dark) -> Section 8 (Color Mgmt - Light) -> Section 9 (Process - Dark) -> Section 10 (Applications - Light) -> Section 11 (Comparison - Dark) -> Section 12 (Export Map - Light) -> Section 13 (Consultation - Dark) -> Section 14 (Leadership - Light) -> Section 15 (Trust Bar - Dark) -> Section 16 (CTA QR - Light) -> Section 17 (Footer - Dark)

sections_breakdown.name: 1. Cinematic Kinetic Hero
components: Kinetic Hero text with masked reveal
3D Interactive Photopolymer Cylinder / Macro Plate simulation canvas

sections_breakdown.name: 3. Outcomes Metric Strip
components: 4 Counter Cards: Dot Retention, Ink Reduction %, Make-ready Time, Export Countries

sections_breakdown.name: 5. Kodak Flexcel NX Technology Focus
components: Interactive Flat-Top Dot Slider (Conventional Round Dot vs NX Flat Top Dot)

sections_breakdown.name: 8. Advanced Prepress & Color Management
components: G7 Master Pass certification interactive swatch viewer

sections_breakdown.name: 9. Interactive 9-Step Process Flow
components: Step-by-step interactive stepper: File Preflight -> Trapping -> Color Separation -> Screening -> Laser Imaging -> Main Exposure -> Washout -> Drying -> QC Inspection
sections_breakdown.interactive: Clickable steps updating detailed SVG CAD preview

sections_breakdown.name: 10. Applications Gallery
components: 6 Tabs: Flexible Packaging, Premium Labels, Corrugated Box, Paper Bags, Line-O-Matic, Dry-Offset
sections_breakdown.grid: Image gallery with macro detail overlay

sections_breakdown.name: 12. Global Exports Interactive Map
components: Interactive SVG World Map featuring pins and trade lines for: Uganda, Tanzania, Zambia, Sri Lanka, Rwanda, Democratic Republic of Congo
features: Hover popover with export statistics per country

sections_breakdown.name: 13. Technical Consultation Form
components: Sub-surface Form sending to FastAPI /api/enquiry endpoint
Plate thickness selector, cylinder circumference, substrate type selector

sections_breakdown.name: 14. Leadership & Philosophy
components: K. C. Mohan (Chairman) & K. Anandhi (Director) profile cards

sections_breakdown.name: 15. Client Trust Bar
components: Editorial Marquee scrolling converting press partners

sections_breakdown.name: 16. Digital Catalogue CTA & QR Code
components: Live SVG QR Code generator to current URL
Download PDF Button with print stylesheet trigger

sections_breakdown.name: 17. Technical Footer & Logistics Note
components: DHL Express & Atlas Logistics export compliance notice

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion_reveals: Staggered fade-up for section headings, border line animations
motion_and_interactions.parallax_hero: Layered cylinder depth effect on scroll
motion_and_interactions.cursor_hover: Custom subtle circle hover state for interactive diagrams

print_and_pdf.print_css: @media print { body { background: white !important; color: black !important; } .no-print { display: none !important; } .page-break { page-break-after: always; } }
print_and_pdf.download_pdf_button: Triggers window.print() with custom print styling for clear multi-page B2B PDF catalogue output

testing_and_data_ids.rule: All interactive buttons, links, inputs, selectors, tab elements, and printable triggers MUST contain explicit role-based data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the 17 specified sections in a seamless, scroll-driven React architecture with chapter index sticky header.
Ensure strict Swiss grid alignment, hairline borders, and dramatic light-dark alternating full-bleed sections.
Integrate Lenis smooth scrolling and Framer Motion reveals.

Include interactive technical diagrams: Dot Gain Curve comparison, Conventional vs NX Dot toggle slider, Ink savings calculator, 9-Step interactive process stepper, and interactive SVG World Export Map.
Connect the Technical Consultation Form to the FastAPI /api/enquiry endpoint with MongoDB storage.
Implement print-friendly CSS and the Download PDF button for instant client PDF export.
